items.t: Electric power steering assist cuts out (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering motor, sensor or column (recall)
items.note: If your car was not covered or the recall is closed, owners report about $600–$1,100 for a column or motor.

items.t: Clunk or pop from the steering when turning
items.job: Replace intermediate steering shaft
items.note: If the rack or tie rods are worn too, the bill is higher.

items.t: Replacement steering shaft can wear out early (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled intermediate steering shaft

items.t: Brake lights and shifter faults from the body module connector (recall)
items.job: Clean and grease body module connector, relearn brake sensor

items.t: Brake lights stay on or don't work from a corroded connector (recall)
items.job: Repair brake lamp wiring connector (recall)

items.t: Shift cable can break, car may not stay in Park (recall)
items.job: Replace or secure transmission shift cable (recall)

items.t: Six-speed automatic loses 3rd, 5th and Reverse
items.job: Replace 3-5-Reverse wave plate (transmission teardown)
items.note: A used or remanufactured transmission is the alternative if other parts are damaged.

items.t: Automatic transmission shifts hard or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report $3,200–$3,500 on average at a shop.

items.t: Low-beam headlights keep burning out or melting the plug
items.job: Replace headlight bulb and melted connector pigtail

items.t: Timing chain rattle or tensioner failure
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner

items.t: Check engine light from cam sensor or cam phaser solenoid
items.job: Replace camshaft position sensor or cam actuator solenoid

items.t: Intake or head gasket coolant leak on the V6
items.job: Replace lower intake manifold gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: A head gasket job costs much more.

items.t: Water pump leak
items.job: Replace water pump and refill coolant

items.t: Clogged or failed catalytic converter
items.job: Replace catalytic converter
items.note: V6 models have more than one converter.

items.t: Retractable hardtop won't open or close
items.job: Diagnose and replace convertible top switch or hydraulic part
items.note: Parts are getting hard to find, so prices vary widely.

items.t: Front rotors warp early, brake pedal pulses
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Clunking from the front suspension over bumps
items.job: Replace front stabilizer end links (and bushings)
items.note: Struts or control arms cost more.

items.t: Worn tie rod ends
items.job: Replace outer tie rod ends and align

items.t: Front wheel bearing humming
items.job: Replace front wheel hub bearing

items.t: Starter failure
items.job: Replace starter

items.t: Oil leaks from the oil pan or valve cover gaskets
items.job: Replace oil pan or valve cover gasket

items.t: Heater fan only works on some speeds
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor

items.t: Passenger airbag may not turn off for a small child (recall)
items.job: Recalibrate passenger sensing system (recall)

items.t: Aftermarket seat covers confuse the passenger airbag sensor (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct passenger sensing with seat covers (recall)

items.t: Rear center child seat anchors and manual mismatch (recall)
items.job: Owner's manual insert (recall)
